name: Agora Market
address: N. Domingo St., San Juan City
description: A bustling wet market in San Juan known for fresh vegetables, meat, and seafood at competitive prices.
description_tl: Isang sikat na wet market sa San Juan na kilala sa mga sariwang gulay, karne, at seafood sa abot-kayang presyo.

name: New Muntinlupa Public Market
description: One of the largest public markets in Muntinlupa, serving the Alabang area with fresh produce, fish, and poultry.
description_tl: Isa sa pinakamalaking pampublikong palengke sa Muntinlupa, na nagbibigay ng sariwang ani, isda, at karne sa lugar ng Alabang.

name: Balintawak (Cloverleaf) Market
address: EDSA cor. A. Bonifacio, Balintawak, Quezon City
description: One of Metro Manila's largest wholesale markets for fruits, vegetables, and root crops. A major supply hub for retailers across NCR.
description_tl: Isa sa pinakamalaking wholesale na palengke sa Metro Manila para sa prutas, gulay, at halamang-ugat. Pangunahing pinagkukuhanan ng supply sa buong NCR.

name: Bicutan Market
address: Gen. Paulino Santos Ave., Bicutan, Taguig
description: A community wet market in Lower Bicutan offering fresh fish, meat, and everyday grocery items to Taguig residents.
description_tl: Isang komunidad na wet market sa Lower Bicutan na nag-aalok ng sariwang isda, karne, at pang-araw-araw na pangangailangan para sa mga taga-Taguig.

name: Cartimar Market
description: A well-known Pasay market offering fresh seafood, meats, and vegetables alongside pet supplies and other goods.
description_tl: Isang kilalang palengke sa Pasay na may sariwang seafood, karne, at gulay, kasama ng mga pet supplies at iba pang produkto.

name: Commonwealth Market
description: A busy neighborhood market in Commonwealth, QC, providing fresh produce, meat, and fish to nearby communities.
description_tl: Isang abalang palengke sa Commonwealth, QC, na nagbibigay ng sariwang ani, karne, at isda sa mga kalapit na komunidad.

name: Farmers Market
address: Gen. MacArthur Ave., Araneta City, Cubao, Quezon City
description: Located inside Araneta City, Cubao. Popular for affordable fresh fruits, vegetables, seafood, and local delicacies.
description_tl: Matatagpuan sa loob ng Araneta City, Cubao. Kilala sa mga murang sariwang prutas, gulay, seafood, at mga lokal na kakanin.

name: Grace Marketplace
description: A compact market in Pateros known for local produce, fresh fish, and the town's famous balut (duck eggs).
description_tl: Isang siksik na palengke sa Pateros na kilala sa mga lokal na ani, sariwang isda, at sikat na balut ng bayan.

name: Guadalupe Commercial Complex
description: A large commercial complex in Makati featuring a wet market with fresh seafood, meats, and vegetables alongside cooked food stalls.
description_tl: Isang malaking commercial complex sa Makati na may wet market ng sariwang seafood, karne, at gulay, kasama ng mga lutong pagkain.

name: La Huerta Public Market
description: A neighborhood market in Parañaque serving La Huerta residents with fresh produce, fish, and household essentials.
description_tl: Isang palengke sa Parañaque na nagbibigay sa mga taga-La Huerta ng sariwang ani, isda, at mga pang-araw-araw na pangangailangan.

name: Malabon Central Market
description: The main public market of Malabon City, renowned for fresh fish and seafood given the city's fishing heritage.
description_tl: Pangunahing pampublikong palengke ng Malabon, kilala sa sariwang isda at seafood dahil sa yamang-dagat ng siyudad.

name: Mandaluyong Public Market
address: Gen. Kalentong St., Pag-asa, Mandaluyong City
description: A well-organized public market in Mandaluyong offering fresh vegetables, meat, fish, and dry goods to the local community.
description_tl: Isang maayos na pampublikong palengke sa Mandaluyong na may alok na sariwang gulay, karne, isda, at iba pang produkto sa komunidad.

name: Marikina Public Market
address: Padre Burgos St., Sta. Elena, Marikina City
description: The central public market of Marikina City, known for its cleanliness and wide selection of fresh food and local products.
description_tl: Pangunahing pampublikong palengke ng Marikina, kilala sa kalinisan at malawak na pagpipilian ng sariwang pagkain at lokal na produkto.

name: Maypajo Public Market
address: J.P. Rizal St., Maypajo, Caloocan City
description: A busy market in Caloocan offering affordable fresh produce, meats, and seafood to the densely populated Maypajo area.
description_tl: Abalang palengke sa Caloocan na may murang sariwang ani, karne, at seafood para sa mataong lugar ng Maypajo.

name: Mega Q-mart
address: Ermin Garcia St., Cubao, Quezon City
description: A modern wet market in Cubao, QC, providing a wide range of fresh commodities including fruits, vegetables, and seafood.
description_tl: Modernong wet market sa Cubao, QC, na may malawak na uri ng sariwang produkto tulad ng prutas, gulay, at seafood.

name: Muñoz Market
description: A neighborhood market near the Muñoz area of QC, popular for fresh vegetables, meat, and affordable daily essentials.
description_tl: Isang palengke malapit sa Muñoz sa QC, sikat para sa sariwang gulay, karne, at murang pang-araw-araw na pangangailangan.

name: Murphy Public Market
address: 1st Camarilla St., San Roque, Cubao, Quezon City
description: A compact community market near Cubao serving the Murphy district with fresh produce, fish, and meat at local prices.
description_tl: Siksik na pampamayanang palengke malapit sa Cubao na naglilingkod sa distrito ng Murphy na may sariwang ani, isda, at karne sa presyong abot-kaya.

name: Mutya ng Pasig Mega Market
address: San Agustin Ave., Palatiw, Pasig City
description: One of Pasig's largest markets, offering a wide variety of fresh fish, meat, vegetables, and dry goods under one roof.
description_tl: Isa sa pinakamalaking palengke sa Pasig, na may malawak na pagpipilian ng sariwang isda, karne, gulay, at iba pang produkto sa iisang bubong.

name: Navotas Agora Market
address: Lapu-Lapu Ave., Navotas Fishport Complex, Navotas City
description: A major fish and seafood wholesale hub in Navotas, supplying fresh catch from Manila Bay to markets across Metro Manila.
description_tl: Pangunahing bagsakan ng isda at seafood sa Navotas, nagsusuplay ng sariwang huli mula sa Manila Bay papunta sa iba't ibang palengke sa Metro Manila.

name: New Las Piñas City Public Market
address: Aldebaran St., Zapote, Las Piñas City
description: The primary public market of Las Piñas City, offering fresh produce, meats, seafood, and local goods to south Metro Manila residents.
description_tl: Pangunahing palengke ng Las Piñas City, na may sariwang ani, karne, seafood, at lokal na produkto para sa mga taga-katimugang Metro Manila.

name: New Marulas Public Market
description: A renovated public market in Valenzuela serving the Marulas community with fresh fish, vegetables, and daily commodities.
description_tl: Pinaayos na pampublikong palengke sa Valenzuela na nagbibigay sa komunidad ng Marulas ng sariwang isda, gulay, at pang-araw-araw na pangangailangan.

name: Obrero Public Market
description: A traditional Manila market in Tondo offering fresh fish, vegetables, and meats at very affordable prices for local residents.
description_tl: Tradisyunal na palengke ng Manila sa Tondo na nag-aalok ng sariwang isda, gulay, at karne sa murang presyo para sa mga lokal na residente.

name: Pasay City Public Market
description: The main public market of Pasay City, centrally located and known for fresh produce, meats, and seafood at competitive prices.
description_tl: Pangunahing palengke ng Pasay City, nasa sentro at kilala sa mga sariwang ani, karne, at seafood sa abot-kayang presyo.

name: Pritil Market
description: A historic market in Tondo, Manila, serving as a key source of fresh fish, vegetables, and meat for nearby communities.
description_tl: Makasaysayang palengke sa Tondo, Manila, na nagsisilbing mahalagang pinagkukuhanan ng sariwang isda, gulay, at karne para sa mga kalapit na lugar.

name: Quinta Market
description: One of Manila's oldest public markets near Quiapo, offering a wide variety of fresh produce, seafood, and local goods.
description_tl: Isa sa mga pinakalumang palengke ng Manila malapit sa Quiapo, nag-aalok ng malawak na pagpipilian ng sariwang ani, seafood, at lokal na produkto.

name: San Andres Market
description: A well-known Manila market famous for fresh fruits, exotic produce, and imported goods at wholesale prices.
description_tl: Kilalang palengke sa Manila na sikat sa mga sariwang prutas, bihirang ani, at imported na produkto sa murang presyo.

name: Taguig People's Market
address: Gen. Paulino Santos Ave., Lower Bicutan, Taguig City
description: A community-oriented public market in Tuktukan, Taguig, providing fresh fish, meat, vegetables, and everyday essentials.
description_tl: Isang komunidad na palengke sa Tuktukan, Taguig, naglalaan ng sariwang isda, karne, gulay, at pang-araw-araw na pangangailangan.

name: Trabajo Market
description: A traditional wet market in Tondo, Manila, known for affordable fresh seafood, vegetables, and meats for local households.
description_tl: Tradisyunal na wet market sa Tondo, Manila, kilala sa murang sariwang seafood, gulay, at karne para sa mga lokal na pamilya.
